human_decision_reason: BK/Human Creative Owner must approve, redirect, or reject the Phase 4B asset roles and reuse candidates before any owner review gate can authorize implementation.
acceptance_criteria: The package defines Phase 4B gameplay-readable asset needs for hazard, collectible or progression item, goal marker, and section landmark.
The package explicitly records whether each need reuses an existing Phase 3 prepared asset, has no acceptable reuse candidate, or requires future new art generation.
The CSV and JSON review surfaces are human-readable and map each required asset role to candidate evidence or a reuse gap.
The preview surface lets BK approve, redirect, or reject each asset role without inspecting raw JSON.
The Art note separates prototype review utility from final art direction, production asset approval, and implementation authorization.
No new images, Godot files, owner review artifacts, QA reviews, Learning Cards, schema files, agent profiles, lifecycle moves, or git operations are changed by WP-032 execution.
notes: This Work Package chooses explicit reuse from Phase 3 prepared assets because Phase 4B needs a gameplay-readable imported asset category but does not require new image generation before owner review. It stops before owner review, Godot implementation, QA, learning capture, closeout, staging, committing, or pushing.
